HL-1.name: subtask_handoff_stall
HL-1.definition: pi0 completes a subtask (a fixture action or a successful grasp) and then idles; the next subtask never starts.
HL-1.remedy: VERIFY(prev done) -> HALT -> RETREAT 10 cm (back into view) -> REPROMPT next-subtask sentence -> WATCH 3 s; retry once -> ESCALATE
HL-1.prevention: one subtask per prompt, advance only on VERIFY

HL-2.name: scene_default_skill_override
HL-2.definition: pi0 runs the scene's habitual skill or fixture interaction (usually from a trained libero_10/libero_spatial task) instead of the instructed skill.
HL-2.remedy: HALT -> RETREAT 10 cm + 5 cm from attractor -> INSERT_SUBTASK to restore any broken protected state -> POINT_APPROACH(target) -> REPROMPT object-first sentence -> WATCH 5 s; retry 15 cm -> ESCALATE
HL-2.prevention: declare protected states; POINT_APPROACH fixtures before the first pi0 step

HL-3.name: wrong_object_category
HL-3.definition: pi0 grasps/manipulates an object of a different category than the instructed target, typically an object from a trained task in the same scene.
HL-3.remedy: pre-grasp VERIFY(object between fingers is target) -> HALT -> put wrong object back -> RETREAT 10 cm -> POINT_APPROACH(target) -> REPROMPT pick-place sentence -> VERIFY(grasped); retry -> ESCALATE
HL-3.prevention: list trained-task objects as distractors; pre-grasp VERIFY on every pick

HL-4.name: referring_expression_instance_error
HL-4.definition: pi0 picks the right kind of object or fixture but the wrong instance; the qualifier (left/right/middle/back, colour, top/bottom drawer) is ignored or mirrored.
HL-4.remedy: pre-grasp/pre-pull VERIFY phrased on the qualifier (3x zoom) -> HALT -> RETREAT -> POINT_APPROACH(resolved instance) -> REPROMPT -> VERIFY; retry -> ESCALATE
HL-4.prevention: coordinator resolves qualifiers in the robot frame (robot-left = image-right) and passes a pointed target

HL-5.name: intermediate_subtask_skipped
HL-5.definition: In a multi-step instruction, pi0 skips a middle subtask (e.g. the stack) and carries a single object straight to the final destination.
HL-5.remedy: HALT before the single object reaches the container -> stack in place if base already in container, else POINT_APPROACH(top) + REPROMPT stack sentence -> VERIFY(stacked) -> REPROMPT place sentence for the base
HL-5.prevention: split stack and place into two VERIFY-gated prompts

HL-6.name: destination_misgrounding
HL-6.definition: pi0 holds the correct object but carries it to, hovers at, or places it in a non-instructed destination/relation (often the trained task's destination), or wanders without committing to the instructed one.
HL-6.remedy: HALT keeping grasp -> RETREAT up 10 cm -> POINT_APPROACH(destination point) -> REPROMPT place sentence or scripted lower-and-release -> VERIFY(on/in); retry -> ESCALATE
HL-6.prevention: coordinator converts relation/compartment words into a destination point before the carry

HL-7.name: target_never_approached
HL-7.definition: pi0 hovers or wanders among other objects and fixtures for the whole episode and never approaches the instructed target.
HL-7.remedy: early heading check (2-3 frames) -> HALT -> RETREAT -> POINT_APPROACH(target) -> REPROMPT -> WATCH 3 s -> ESCALATE
HL-7.prevention: VLM heading check in the first 2-3 frames

HL-8.name: grasp_loss_unnoticed
HL-8.definition: After a missed or slipped grasp, pi0 continues the transport/place motion with an empty gripper instead of re-grasping.
HL-8.remedy: post-grasp VERIFY(object between fingers, width > 0) fails -> HALT -> RETREAT 10 cm -> POINT_APPROACH(object) -> INVOKE_RL(rl/pick) or REPROMPT pick sentence -> VERIFY; retry -> ESCALATE
HL-8.prevention: VERIFY grasp after every pick before transport

LL-1.name: drawer_push_stall
LL-1.definition: While closing a drawer, the push stalls 1/2-2/3 of the way and the hand rests on the drawer front.

LL-2.name: hinged_door_pull_stall
LL-2.definition: pi0 hooks a hinged door's handle and swings it partly open, then stops pulling short of the open threshold.

LL-3.name: knob_approach_contortion
LL-3.definition: Approaching a small fixture (stove knob), the wrist/elbow folds into a twisted configuration, touches the knob with the wrist body instead of the fingertips, and the arm swings away without turning it.

LL-4.name: unstable_grasp_slip
LL-4.definition: The grasp closes on a rim, edge or handle; during lift or transport the object tilts, pivots or slips out of the gripper.

LL-5.name: pregrasp_contact_disturbance
LL-5.definition: A misaligned descent or reach knocks over, pushes or tips the target (or a neighbouring receptacle) before a grasp is formed.

LL-6.name: placement_instability
LL-6.definition: The object is released off-centre, at an edge or tilted, so it falls off the support, tips over, or overhangs the region and the predicate fails.

LL-7.name: place_release_stall
LL-7.definition: The object is brought to (or just beside) the correct destination but pi0 keeps adjusting and never lowers/releases it before timeout.

LL-8.name: pregrasp_hesitation
LL-8.definition: The gripper hovers next to the correct target with small adjustments for many seconds before (or instead of) closing, exhausting the step budget.
